name: Mid-market B2B SaaS revenue team
description: B2B software company with 50-1,000 employees, Series B or later. Buyers: VP Marketing, Head of Demand Gen, RevOps lead or CRO. Runs HubSpot or Salesforce with paid ads, content and SDR outbound. Pain: can't prove which channels drive pipeline, poor lead quality, sales ignores MQLs, manual reporting in spreadsheets.

name: Industrial manufacturer going digital
description: Manufacturer or industrial distributor with 200-5,000 employees selling through dealers and direct sales. Buyers: Marketing Director, VP Sales, Digital Transformation lead. Pain: website and trade-show leads lost in email, no CRM discipline, long quoting cycles, need to see ROI from digital marketing spend.

name: Regulated fintech or financial services
description: Fintech, payments, lending or wealth-management firm with 50-2,000 employees in a regulated market. Buyers: CMO, Head of Growth, Marketing Ops. Pain: consent and privacy-safe tracking (server-side), attribution across long consideration cycles, compliance review of marketing data, high customer acquisition cost.
